incident.down.message: {name}: {hasError, select, yes {{error}} other {API errors}}{hasOp, select, yes { on {op}} other {}} · health check failed.
incident.down.note: the outage timeline; error: the status and code of the failed call (503 ServiceUnavailable); op: the call (SendEmail)

incident.authDown.message: {name} rejected the credentials: {hasError, select, yes {{error}} other {API errors}}{hasOp, select, yes { on {op}} other {}}.
incident.authDown.note: the outage timeline: the provider refused ReputeCast's credentials

incident.failover.message: {stream, select, broadcast {Broadcasts} automation {Automations} transactional {Transactional} other {System}}: switched to {fallback} after {count} failed health checks.
incident.failover.note: fallback: the provider now carrying the stream

incident.held.message: Broadcasts: {campaign} {short} share held, {count} recipients. Decision requested.
incident.held.note: campaign: the campaign's name in quotes; short: the provider (SES)

incident.failoverEnded.message: {stream, select, broadcast {Broadcasts} automation {Automations} transactional {Transactional} other {System}}: back on {short} after {minutes} healthy minutes.

incident.recovered.note: minutes: how long it was down

incident.silent.message: {name}: no webhook events since {since, time} while mail went out.

incident.failoverVetted.message: {stream, select, broadcast {Broadcasts} automation {Automations} transactional {Transactional} other {System}}: switched to {fallback} after {count} failed health checks; {fallback} passed its checks first.
incident.failoverVetted.note: PR-7: the fallback was vetted (sending domain verified, quota free, not in sandbox, warm) before any mail moved

incident.fallbackFailed.message: {stream, select, broadcast {Broadcasts} automation {Automations} transactional {Transactional} other {System}}: {fallback} didn't pass its checks, so ReputeCast keeps retrying {name} instead of switching.
incident.fallbackFailed.note: PR-7: the fallback failed a check (domain not verified, quota short, sandbox…); name: the provider that is down

incident.rejecting.message: {name} refused {rejected, number} of {total, number} messages in {minutes} min.{hasAnswer, select, yes { Last answer: {answer}} other {}}
incident.rejecting.note: PR-7: the provider answered that it won't send these messages (an unverified sender, a suspended account); answer: its code and words

notify.rejectingTitle.note: a notification to the members who manage providers

notify.rejectingBody: It refused {rejected, number} of {total, number} messages in the last {minutes} min.{hasAnswer, select, yes { Last answer: {answer}.} other {}} Refused messages weren't sent. Check the sender's domain and the account at {name}.

incident.mailboxFailing.message: {name}: the bounce mailbox {mailbox} can't be read since {since, time}: {error}. Bounces from this server aren't processed.
incident.mailboxFailing.note: PR-10: an SMTP server's bounces arrive in a mailbox ReputeCast reads; error: what the mail server or the network said

incident.mailboxOK: {name}: the bounce mailbox can be read again.
notify.mailboxTitle: {name}: the bounce mailbox can't be read
notify.mailboxBody: ReputeCast couldn't read {mailbox} since {since, time} ({error}). Until it can, bounces from this server don't reach the suppression list. Check the mailbox's password and server settings.

notify.downTitle.note: a notification to the members who manage providers

notify.downBody.message: {hasError, select, yes {{error}} other {API errors}}{hasOp, select, yes { on {op}} other {}} since {since, time}.{autoCount, plural, =0 {} other { {auto} failed over automatically.}}{heldCount, plural, =0 {} other { {held} wait for you.}}
notify.downBody.note: error: the failed call's status and code; auto and held: the streams that moved to another provider and the ones that wait for a decision, joined with and; autoCount and heldCount: how many

notify.heldTitle.note: a notification to the members who can send; campaign: its name in quotes

notify.heldBody.message: {name} is down. Its share ({count, plural, other {{countText} recipients}}) is held; the rest keeps sending.
notify.heldBody.note: count: the recipients held; countText: the same number as the English writes it

notify.silentTitle: {name} webhooks have been silent for 6 hours
notify.silentBody: No delivery, bounce or complaint events since {since, time}. Bounce protection for this route is blind; its share of Broadcasts is held.
